CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (ForgottenRitual.cs:21) == `exhausts = True`. Unlike card/evil_eye, whose Exhaust hover tip is only a reference, this card really does exhaust itself.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (ForgottenRitual.cs:35-38) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

OnPlay.rationale: `if (WasCardExhaustedThisTurn) { ... GainEnergy(Energy.IntValue) }` (ForgottenRitual.cs:42-48) == `if ctx.combat.history.card_exhausted_this_turn(): EnergyCmd.gain(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._energy)`, and the predicate is the same history query card/evil_eye uses (`History.Entries.OfType<CardExhaustedEntry>().Any(e => e.HappenedThisTurn(CombatState) && e.Card.Owner == Owner)`, ForgottenRitual.cs:33). The TIMING subtlety is right on both sides and the sim's docstring states it: the card's OWN Exhaust keyword fires AFTER OnPlay (combat.py:498-502 moves it to the exhaust pile after the play-count loop), so a first Forgotten Ritual does not pay for itself. Presentation, folded in: the purple ground-fire VFX (44-45), TriggerAnim (46) and ShouldGlowGoldInternal (19).
